places.name: Sochi Olympic Park
places.ai_summary: A modern sports complex built for the 2014 Winter Olympics, featuring stadiums, museums, and a vibrant promenade.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the fountain show.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking around the park.

places.name: Rosa Khutor Alpine Resort
places.ai_summary: A famous ski resort in the Caucasus Mountains, known for its winter sports facilities and beautiful landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Ski season typically runs from December to April.

places.best_time_to_visit: Winter for skiing, Summer for hiking
places.place_tip: Check the weather and snow conditions before your visit.
places.address: Rosa Khutor, Krasnaya Polyana, Sochi, Krasnodar Krai, Russia

places.name: Sochi Arboretum (Dendrarium)
places.ai_summary: A beautiful botanical garden in Sochi, featuring a diverse collection of plants from around the world.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Wednesdays from November to March.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the tropical and subtropical plant sections.
places.address: Kurortny Ave, 74, Sochi, Krasnodar Krai, Russia

places.name: Krasnaya Polyana Mountains
places.ai_summary: A mountain range near Sochi, popular for skiing, hiking, and breathtaking views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for hiking and sightseeing.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks when hiking; trails can be challenging.
places.address: Krasnaya Polyana, Sochi, Krasnodar Krai, Russia

places.name: Lake Ritsa (nearby Abkhazia, often visited from Sochi)
places.ai_summary: A stunning lake located in the Ritsa National Park, known for its emerald waters and surrounding mountains.
places.cost: Varies (entry to national park may have a fee)

opening_hours.notes: Best visited from May to October; check border crossing requirements.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour for a more informative and safe visit.

places.name: Riviera Park (Sochi)
places.ai_summary: A large and popular park in Sochi, featuring attractions, cafes, and beautiful walking paths along the coast.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a boat ride or visit the dolphinarium while in the park.

places.name: Sochi Autodrom (Formula 1 Track)
places.ai_summary: A modern racing circuit in Sochi, host of the Russian Grand Prix and other motorsport events.

opening_hours.notes: Check the event schedule for specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular events like the Formula 1 Grand Prix.

places.name: Mount Akhun Viewing Tower
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint in Sochi, offering panoramic views of the Black Sea and surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Drive or hike to the top; the road can be steep and winding.

places.name: 33 Waterfalls (Sochi)
places.ai_summary: A scenic area in Sochi with a series of beautiful waterfalls, popular for hiking and nature walks.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the spring when the waterfalls are most active.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes and be prepared for a moderate hike.

places.ai_summary: The former summer residence of Joseph Stalin in Sochi, now a museum and historical site.

opening_hours.notes: Audio guides available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Sochi Arboretum.

places.name: Anapa Beaches
places.ai_summary: Popular beaches located in the city of Anapa, known for their sandy shores and family-friendly atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the summer months.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good spot, especially on weekends.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available in Russian and English.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Anapa Beaches.

places.ai_summary: A scenic waterfront promenade in Gelendzhik, perfect for leisurely walks and enjoying the sea view.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a sunset stroll.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood at one of the nearby restaurants.

places.place_tip: Visit the reptile house and the bird show.

places.name: Abrau-Dyurso Winery
places.ai_summary: A famous winery located in the village of Abrau-Dyurso, known for its sparkling wines and beautiful vineyard views.

opening_hours.notes: Wine tasting tours available; advance booking recommended.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to taste the local sparkling wine.

places.name: Taman Peninsula Archaeological Sites
places.ai_summary: Ancient archaeological sites located on the Taman Peninsula, offering a glimpse into the region's historical civilizations.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available; check site-specific hours.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and be prepared for outdoor walking.

places.ai_summary: A stunning marble canyon located in Karelia, often visited from Sochi for its breathtaking views and hiking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the summer months; check for guided tour availability.

places.place_tip: Book a guided tour for a more informative experience.

places.name: Novorossiysk War Memorial
places.ai_summary: A memorial complex in Novorossiysk, dedicated to the heroes of the Great Patriotic War.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Novorossiysk city beach.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike to explore the park more easily.

places.ai_summary: A mysterious area in Krasnodar Krai, known for its anomalous phenomena and natural beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore the area with a guide to learn about its unique features.
